name: SunSpark Technology
old_description: SunSpark Technology manufactures thin-film photovoltaic panels using cadmium telluride technology. Solar modules, built with tempered glass and anodized aluminum, serve commercial, government, military and industrial clients.
about: SunSpark Technology, based in Hemet, California, with a facility in Riverside, was founded in 2008 as a manufacturer of solar photovoltaic panels and modules. The company produces thin-film photovoltaic panels using cadmium telluride technology, as well as monocrystalline and polycrystalline PV panels. Solar modules are built with tempered glass and anodized aluminum frames. The operation employs 10 to 49 people; facility size and production volumes are not disclosed. SunSpark serves commercial, industrial, military, and government customers, along with residential clients. Its modules are used in commercial rooftops, industrial facilities, military installations, and government projects. The company emphasizes cutting-edge engineering and design practices to guarantee high-quality results, driven by a passion for creating superior solar modules that deliver optimal sustainability and efficiency.
